kpi_metadata.Description:
Overview

Description:

Memory Dump files contain secrets and PII. Azure Watson Service is the required compliant and secure system to debug those dump files. All ServiceTree GA services need to onboard and utilize Azure Watson (http://aka.ms/azurewatson).

Business Impact:

Maintain compliance and security for memory dump files. Azure Watson ensures that dump files remain in the region where they were created, which is a compliance requirement. It audits all bytes sent and received by a developer when debugging a dump file. It ensures that dump files do not leave the Azure Cloud and all access to the dump file is audited. It secures which users have access to the dump files.

Required Action

For Windows: https://aka.ms/azwonboard

For Linux: Onboarding a Linux Service

For AKS: Running Watson on Containerized Workloads on Linux

Services need to update their MA config to enable Azure Watson to collect all crash dumps. Azure Security Pack scans for specific registry keys set by Azure Watson to validate if Azure Watson has been enabled for each VM. All Microsoft services should have Azure Watson Enabled. The AzSecPack being enabled is a pre-req. If AzSecpack is not installed or has an exception, then Azure Watson KPI will not be flagged.

Troubleshooting Guide (TSG)

For more information, please review the relevant TSG: Azure Watson Not Enabled S360 KPI

Support

For any questions unresolved by the TSG, please contact us through the mechanisms below:

Email: supwatson@microsoft.com

Office Hours: occurs every alternate Tuesday 9 AM PST (10.30 PM IST) – Meeting Invite
kpi_metadata.FAQs: [{"Question":"How often is this KPI refreshed","Answer":"Please allow at least 24 hours after a change is made for data to refresh in LENS","DisplayOrder":1},{"Question":"Why is Due Date changing - why do I see this change from Out of SLA and Approaching SLA?","Answer":"Our team just resolved an ICM that impacted a very small subset of customer where they saw false positives in the report, all of this was resolved on 4/13/2018 so 1 extra week was added to Due Date","DisplayOrder":2},{"Question":"Where can I go to read more about Azure Watson","Answer":"Please see out Onboarding guide: https://aka.ms/awonboard","DisplayOrder":3},{"Question":"What is the first thing I do to make this KPI go green?","Answer":"Click on the link \"Enable Azure Watson on these Resource\", this will launch LENS with per instance detail where Azure Watson must be enabled","DisplayOrder":4},{"Question":"I opened LENS, now what?","Answer":"The default view will only show Failures, you can adjust LENS to show all states, the most important table in the Details near the bottom that shows each instance","DisplayOrder":5},{"Question":"In LENS, in Details table, what is ReportingIdentity?","Answer":"ReportingIdentity, unless overridden, is the Instance name for your service","DisplayOrder":6},{"Question":"What is the Exception process for this KPI","Answer":"Please reach out to our team (azwsup) if you would like to talk about an exception, this should be very rare though","DisplayOrder":7}]
